title: Multi-creator video selling the Ivy product

segments.text: Got a bit of an idea that's interesting for a video, which is to sell the Ivy product itself. It's to get several creators and have them talking to the device with the hook being that the ideas are connected into
something like Mr. Beast's viral video that I was watching the other day on YouTube,

The video should be pretty short. I'm thinking that we have it in different hands and different people, and that the goal of the video is to make the product, then the AI, and then the output, and then a video all really seamless, all really fun.

And I think fun is the is the goal, is to make the UI and the AI really personable and really, I guess, optimistic around great ideas and talkative, and we can kind of show the visuals of that rather than lots of fun.
Like to have your thoughts on it and put together some ideas and storyboards and even some demo concepts.

cards.title: Several creators talking to the device
cards.gist: A video selling the Ivy product itself by filming several creators talking to the device, hooked on how their ideas get connected.

cards.title: Borrow that viral YouTube structure
cards.gist: She points to a viral YouTube video by a well-known creator she watched recently as the structural reference for connecting the ideas.
cards.their_idea: A viral YouTube video by a well-known creator that links segments together into one connected piece.
cards.her_take: Use that connected-ideas structure as the hook for the Ivy creator video.

cards.title: Short film, device passed between hands
cards.gist: Keep the video short with the device moving between different hands and people, making product to AI to output to finished video feel seamless and fun.

loose_ends.text: Find the viral YouTube video she watched the other day to use as the reference.

requests.text: Give thoughts on the video idea and put together ideas, storyboards and demo concepts.
